title: Automate changelog and onboard aurora-spark-13b-v1.4 perf/metadata profiles
author: Priya Nayar
ci_status: pass (initial perf check flaky -> rerun passed)
description: Motivation: onboarding aurora-spark-13b v1.4 into the model registry with curated performance profiles and automating changelog/release note generation for model metadata updates. This PR bundles: 1) new perf/metadata profiles for aurora-spark-13b v1.4, 2) improvements to the changelog automation pipeline so model metadata edits (version bumps, perf profile additions) produce deterministic release notes, and 3) tests and CI guards to prevent noisy perf regressions from blocking releases. Summary of changes: - Add perf profile YAMLs and metadata for aurora-spark-13b v1.4. - Extend registry index update logic to accept schema v2.1 fields (quantization_profiles, runtime_hints). - Add changelog generator enhancements: better diffing for metadata, grouping by model family, and stable ordering for deterministic output. - Add a small canary perf test and threshold-based assertions so CI only fails on clear regressions (avoids flakiness). Checklist: - [x] Perf profiles validated on perf-lab (internal) - [x] Metadata schema migration covered by unit tests - [x] Changelog generation integration test - [x] Documentation: model page and release notes template updated Rollout plan: merged to main and will trigger registry automation job. If anomalies detected (perf regression or metadata schema parsing errors), jobs will automatically open a rollback PR and notify #model-registry on Slack.
